items.title: Bitcoin besser als Gold und Aktien? JPMorgan überrascht mit Zehnjahresprognose
items.summary: Noch 2017 nannte Jamie Dimon Bitcoin einen Betrug und er würde jeden kündigen, der BTC handelt. Heute rechnet seine Bank mit hohen Renditen. Source: BTC-ECHO BTC-ECHO

items.title: Bitcoin erholt sich: Warum die Finanzmärkte nervös bleiben
items.summary: Für Dezember rechnet die Mehrheit der Marktteilnehmer inzwischen mit einer Zinserhöhung der US-Notenbank. Was bedeutet das für Bitcoin? Source: BTC-ECHO BTC-ECHO

items.title: Bitcoin hovers around $83,000 as AI earnings revive tech, ZEC jumps 11%
items.summary: Strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro sent Asian chip stocks surging, and ZEC led crypto higher after developers set a date for its next network upgrade.

items.title: Bitcoin-Kurs sendet Warnsignale – wie lange hält die Erholung?
items.summary: Nach den jüngsten Kursverlusten versucht Bitcoin wieder Fuß zu fassen. Doch die Erholung steht noch auf wackeligen Beinen. Reicht die Nachfrage für eine Trendwende oder droht der nächste Rücksetzer? Source: BTC-ECHO BTC-ECHO

items.title: Musk's SpaceX Earnings Rocket Higher as Bitcoin Stash Holds Firm
items.summary: SpaceX delivered a blockbuster third quarter, generating $14.6 billion in revenue, $4.4 billion in net income, and $8.8 billion in adjusted EBITDA. Behind those extraordinary earnings, Elon Musk's company reported $1.573 billion in digital assets, consistent with its previously disclosed bitcoin holdings of 18,712 BTC…

items.title: JPMorgan Puts a Number on Bitcoin for the First Time: 10% a Year, With a Big Caveat
items.summary: J.P. Morgan Asset Management's 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions project a 10% annual return for Bitcoin over 10 to 15 years, though the firm isn't adding it to its main portfolio models.

items.title: Swiss Financial Regulator Gives Green Light to Country's First Bitcoin ETF
items.summary: Bitcoin exchange-traded funds were only available to institutional investors – until now. This post Swiss Financial Regulator Gives Green Light to Country's First Bitcoin ETF first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Bitcoin Treasury Strive Debuts New Preferred Stock With 15% Dividend
items.summary: Strive's second preferred stock offering, SATS, debuted Tuesday on the Nasdaq. This post Bitcoin Treasury Strive Debuts New Preferred Stock With 15% Dividend first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Post Their Best Day in Nearly a Month as BlackRock Does All the Buying
items.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $526.7 million on Monday, their biggest day since Sept. 22. BlackRock's IBIT supplied all of it while Fidelity and Grayscale funds bled.
